title: Raw rational pairs and locally constant smooth-center blowup reachability
statement: A raw rational pair consists of schemes $X,Z$ [def-pc-scheme], a structure morphism $p:Z\to\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Q$ [def-weil-scheme-over-base], and a morphism $i:X\to Z$, without smoothness, reducedness, separatedness or embedding assumptions. A smooth-center step from $(X,Z,p,i)$ to $(X^{\prime},Z^{\prime},p^{\prime},i^{\prime})$ consists of a quasi-coherent ideal center $C\subset Z$, a closed immersion $c:C\hookrightarrow X$ with $ic$ the center inclusion [def-weil-closed-immersion], such that $C\to\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Q$ is smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] and $H_{X/\mathbf Q}\circ c$ is locally constant on $C$ [def-trf-hilbert-samuel-invariant], together with isomorphisms $Z^{\prime}\simeq\operatorname{Bl}_C(Z)$ [def-nagata-global-blowup] and $X^{\prime}\simeq X^{\mathrm{st}}$ [def-nagata-strict-transform] commuting with the ambient inclusion and rational structure maps. A pair is reachable from another if it is connected to it by finitely many such steps, including zero steps. No smoothness or reducedness assumption is imposed on later pairs; the empty center and centers containing whole components are allowed.
